many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

description: Use when an ARC grid contains scattered 0s and demos recolor multi-cell zero groups. Preserve singleton zeros; recolor each 4-connected zero component of size >1 as 8.
---

# ARC: Recolor connected zero groups

## Rule
Preserve the grid dimensions and all nonzero cells. Find connected components of cells equal to `0` using **orthogonal (up/down/left/right) adjacency only**. Replace every `0` in a component of size greater than one with `8`. Leave isolated (size-one) zeros unchanged.

## Workflow
1. Copy the input grid.
2. Traverse the zero cells with flood fill/BFS/DFS, tracking visited coordinates.
3. For each component, if its size is >1, write `8` to all those coordinates in the copied grid.
4. Keep singleton zero components and all other colors unchanged.
5. Check output dimensions and verify no diagonal-only grouping was applied.

## Validation insight
A demonstration of this pattern shows multi-cell orthogonally connected zero blobs transformed wholesale to 8, while isolated zeros and all 1s remain unchanged. Apply to fresh inputs by recomputing components, not by reusing old coordinates.",
